context:
Goal: degen batch #428 ships, proven once on the Mac, and the UI suite becomes trustworthy.
Problem (risk): the UI step decides whether #428 can merge, but it has never passed and takes over twice as long as the rest.
Based on (measured): milestone run 41792080302 (runner 9, 03:01 CST): suite + app build PASS in 28 min 34 s; the UI step ran 61 min 33 s, unfinished, with 17 UI test failures (MediaBarUITests 5, KeepHandClaimUITests 2, InfiniteFeedUITests 2, eight others 1 each); the 90 min cap cancelled the run at 02:55 CST. It is the first run ever to reach the UI step, so the UI suite was never green on this runner. No lane caused it.
Departs from: main, where milestone-proof runs the UI step after the build — a moves it out of the proof.

lastAnswer.note: Routed 07:52 CST Nov 5 to the coordinator.

options.how: The native-check line rests on suite + app build, which passed. A degen lane fixes the 17 UI failures and runs them in their own job.
options.label: Split the UI step out of milestone-proof
options.lose: UI flows are unproven until that lane lands.

options.how: #428 stays a draft until a lane fixes the 17 UI failures and the milestone run is green.
options.label: Hold #428 until the UI suite passes
options.lose: #428 and every degen merge wait for 17 UI fixes.

reply: Your pick a is with the coordinator: the UI step moves out of milestone-proof, #428 ships on suite plus build, and the UI tests get their own lane. This item closes when that lane merges.
title: degen: the UI test suite has never passed. Ship #428 on suite + build, and fix the UI tests in their own lane?
why: Recommended: a. Suite + build passed, the UI failures predate #428, and a hold would stop every degen merge.
